fullPassage:
The early grain trade firms were active in both surplus-producing and food deficit regions, and these firms made it their business to know the state of supply and demand in both. Because this information was the key to their ____________________, these firms worked in relative secrecy, frequently built on family ties, trust, and loyalty. In addition, these firms were able to benefit from the rise of commodity exchanges and commodities futures markets that emerged in the mid-1800s. Agricultural markets are naturally unstable, due to changes in harvest size that result from variable weather patterns and other factors. Locking-in prices by buying and selling grain for future delivery helped these firms to minimize such risks. It made sense for the grain trading companies to manage their risks within a single firm that was operating in more than one country, rather than operating as independent national companies trading with each other. Their access to information in multiple markets enabled them to easily cover the risks associated with agricultural commodity trade.

* deficit: 부족

questions.passage: The early grain trade firms were active in both surplus-producing and food deficit regions, and these firms made it their business to know the state of supply and demand in both. Because this information was the key to their profitability, these firms ①<u>worked</u> in relative secrecy, frequently ②<u>built</u> on family ties, trust, and loyalty. In addition, these firms were able to ③<u>benefit</u> from the rise of commodity exchanges and commodities futures markets that ④<u>emerging</u> in the mid-1800s.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①worked(과거형), ②built(과거분사), ③benefit(동사원형: able to + 원형)은 어법에 맞습니다. ④emerging은 관계대명사 that 뒤 동사 자리이므로 emerged(과거형)가 올바릅니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① worked: 과거 시제 정상
✅ ② built: 과거분사 (frequently built on~)
✅ ③ benefit: were able to + 동사원형
❌ ④ emerging → emerged: that + 동사(과거) 필요
det.tip: 관계대명사 that 뒤 동사 시제: 주절이 과거이면 종속절도 과거. emerging은 진행형(was emerging) 필요

questions.passage: Agricultural markets are naturally unstable, due to changes in harvest size that result from variable weather patterns and other factors. Locking-in prices by buying and ①<u>selling</u> grain for future delivery helped these firms to ②<u>minimize</u> such risks. It made sense for the grain trading companies to manage their risks within a single firm that was ③<u>operating</u> in more than one country, rather than ④<u>operate</u> as independent national companies trading with each other.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①selling(동명사 병렬), ②minimize(to부정사), ③operating(진행형)은 정상입니다. ④operate는 앞의 operating과 병렬이므로 operating이 올바릅니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① selling: buying and selling 병렬 동명사
✅ ② minimize: helped + to minimize
✅ ③ operating: was operating 진행형
❌ ④ operate → operating: rather than + -ing (앞의 operating과 병렬)
det.tip: rather than + -ing: 앞에 -ing가 오면 rather than 뒤도 -ing로 병렬 구조

questions.passage: The early grain trade firms were active in both surplus-producing and food deficit regions. Because this information was the key to their profitability, these firms worked in relative secrecy. In addition, these firms were able to benefit from the rise of commodity exchanges and commodities futures markets ①<u>that</u> emerged in the mid-1800s. Agricultural markets are naturally ②<u>unstably</u>, due to changes in harvest size ③<u>that</u> result from variable weather patterns and other factors. Their access to information in multiple markets enabled ④<u>them</u> to easily cover the risks.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①that(관계대명사), ③that(관계대명사), ④them(목적격)은 정상입니다. ②unstably(부사)는 be동사 보어 자리이므로 형용사 unstable이 올바릅니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① that: 관계대명사 (markets that emerged)
❌ ② unstably → unstable: are + 형용사 (보어)
✅ ③ that: 관계대명사 (size that result from)
✅ ④ them: enabled them to (목적격)
det.tip: be동사 + 보어: 형용사 필요. are naturally unstable ≠ unstably

questions.passage: The early grain trade firms were active in both surplus-producing and food deficit regions. Locking-in prices by buying and selling grain for future delivery helped these firms ②<u>to minimize</u> such risks. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①trading(현재분사), ②to minimize(to부정사), ④associated(과거분사)는 정상입니다. ③easily의 위치가 잘못되었습니다. 원문은 'to easily cover'이므로 'enabled them easily to cover'는 부자연스럽습니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① trading: 현재분사 (companies trading with each other)
✅ ② to minimize: helped + to부정사
❌ ③ easily: 위치 오류. enabled them to easily cover가 원문
✅ ④ associated: 과거분사 (risks associated with)
det.tip: enable + O + to V 구조에서 부사는 to와 동사 사이(분리부정사): to easily cover

det.analysis:

det.tip: cover the risks ≠ ignore the risks: 위험 관리와 위험 무시는 정반대

questions.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ① 원문은 단일 기업(a single firm)이 합리적이라고 합니다. 독립적 국가별 회사는 rather than 뒤의 부정적 방식입니다.

✅ ③ 일치: Locking-in prices → minimize risks
✅ ④ 일치: access to information → cover the risks
